Hallo', and welcome to /v/BaphoNet!
This subverse primarily serves as a place for discussion on meta / community-highlighted content from BaphoNet, Voat's [unofficial] IRC server.

A quick guide to the IRC server may be found below.

Accessing the IRC Server

Server: irc.veuwer.com   ( If that does not work, try: 23.96.25.98 )
SSL Port: +6697
Main Channel: #voat   ( The pound sign is required. )
Web Client: [KiwiIRC]   ( If that does not work, try: [KiwiIRC] )

SHA-1 fingerprint: 8A:A6:66:F2:01:C6:BC:C4:07:70:28:5F:38:4B:6E:9A:0C:CA:6A:B3

Respect Other Users

Mass spam or untagged NSFW material such as porn or gore in #voat may result in a kick or temp/perm ban from the channel without warning.

All content terms specified in Voat's user agreement apply to BaphoNet as well. Doxing users or posting pornographic content involving minors on either BaphoNet or Voat will result in a global ban.

Recommended IRC Clients

[HexChat], [Quassel IRC], and [mIRC] are available for most major operating systems.
[Textual] is available for OS X (Mac).
[AndChat] (Free) (Donate) is available for Android.
[KiwiIRC] is available for those that would prefer to use a web based client.

Registering and Identifying With Your Nickname

Registering and identifying with your nickname is an important step in ensuring that other users are not able to impersonate you.
Register your nickname after signing in for the first time: /ns REGISTER [password] [email]
On subsequent log-ins, make sure to identify: /ns IDENTIFY [password]
If you lose your connection and the old 'ghost' session is still connected, use: /ns GHOST [nickname] [password]
If someone is using your nickname and their name hasn't yet been changed, use: /ns RECOVER [nickname] [password]

Joining, Registering, and Managing Channels

Join a channel: /join #[channel_name]   ( The pound sign is required. )
Register your own channel: /cs REGISTER #[channel_name] [description]   ( You must first join the channel. )
Prevent unregistered / non-'voiced' users from sending messages: /mode #[channel_name] +m   ( Use -m to disable this. )
Assign users 'voice' mode so that they may talk in a muted channel: /cs VOP #[channel_name] ADD [nickname]   ( Use DEL to remove them. )
Assign users 'operator' status so that they may moderate the channel: /cs AOP #[channel_name] ADD [nickname]   ( Use DEL to remove them. )
Kick users that are spamming: /kick #[channel_name] [nickname] [message]   ( In order to ban repeat offenders, see #irchelp. )

Reclaiming a Stolen or 'Squatted' Nickname / Channel

If your Voat username or subverse has been compromised / registered by another user on the network, enter #opers and see ~moe or ~icydefiance for assistance.

Voat users are assigned ownership priority over the identical nickname on the network.
Subverse owners are assigned ownership priority over the identical channel on the network.

If your Voat username begins with a digit (number), BaphoNet will not allow you to register that as your nickname. Be sure to choose a nickname that matches at least one account that you own (create the matching one if need be) since we will assign ownership priority to whomever owns the respective Voat username.
